description: Updates an existing contact in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated. Returns HTTP 204 with no body on success; use salesforce.get_contact to verify applied changes. Org-level validation rules, duplicate rules, or field-level permissions may reject correctly formatted requests with HTTP 400; inspect the error response to identify the constraint.

account_id.description: Updated Account ID association. Leave empty to keep unchanged. Alternatively use salesforce.associate_contact_to_account, but prefer setting this field when updating multiple fields simultaneously.
account_id.human_parameter_description: The Salesforce Account ID to associate with this contact. Use this to link the contact to a different account.
account_id.title: Account Id

birthdate.description: Updated birthdate in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
birthdate.human_parameter_description: The contact's birthdate in YYYY-MM-DD format. Include this only if you want to update it.
birthdate.title: Birthdate

contact_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the contact to update. Must be a valid 18-character Salesforce ID (retrieve via salesforce.search_contacts); names or emails cannot substitute.
contact_id.human_parameter_description: The Salesforce ID of the contact you want to update. You can copy this from the contact's URL or a previous search result.
contact_id.title: Contact Id

custom_fields.description: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values. Custom fields in Salesforce end with '__c' (e.g., 'Level__c', 'Languages__c').
custom_fields.human_parameter_description: Use this to set custom field values on the contact. Provide a dictionary where keys are the custom field API names (ending in __c) and values are the data to set.
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

department.description: Updated department. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
department.human_parameter_description: The department the contact works in, such as Sales or Marketing. Include only if you’re changing it.
department.title: Department

email.description: Updated email address. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
email.human_parameter_description: The new email address for the contact. Provide this only if you want to change their email.
email.title: Email

first_name.description: Updated first name. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
first_name.human_parameter_description: The new first name for the contact. Leave blank to keep their current first name.
first_name.title: First Name

last_name.description: Updated last name. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
last_name.human_parameter_description: The new last name for the contact. Leave blank to keep the current one.
last_name.title: Last Name

mailing_city.description: Updated mailing city. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
mailing_city.human_parameter_description: The city for the contact’s mailing address. Provide it only if you want to change it.
mailing_city.title: Mailing City

mailing_country.description: Updated mailing country. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
mailing_country.human_parameter_description: The country for the contact’s mailing address, such as United States or Canada.
mailing_country.title: Mailing Country

mailing_postal_code.description: Updated mailing postal/zip code. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
mailing_postal_code.human_parameter_description: The ZIP or postal code for the mailing address. Enter this if you are updating the address.
mailing_postal_code.title: Mailing Postal Code

mailing_state.description: Updated mailing state/province. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
mailing_state.human_parameter_description: The state or province for the mailing address. Use the abbreviation or full name—either is fine.
mailing_state.title: Mailing State

mailing_street.description: Updated mailing street address. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
mailing_street.human_parameter_description: The street line of the contact’s mailing address. Include apartment, suite, or unit if needed.
mailing_street.title: Mailing Street

mobile_phone.description: Updated mobile phone number. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
mobile_phone.human_parameter_description: The contact’s mobile number. Provide this if you want to update their cell phone.
mobile_phone.title: Mobile Phone

phone.description: Updated primary phone number. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
phone.human_parameter_description: The main phone number for the contact. Include the country code if needed.
phone.title: Phone

title.description: Updated job title. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
title.human_parameter_description: The contact’s job title, like 'Sales Manager' or 'CEO'. Fill this in to update it.
title.title: Title

name: update_contact

UpdateContactResponse.description:
Response for successful contact update.

HTTP 204 No Content - Salesforce returns empty body on successful update.
Error responses (4xx/5xx) are handled via raise_for_status().
UpdateContactResponse.title: UpdateContactResponse
